name: Farm
summary: A little drone tends a 6 by 4 field. Plant wheat and pumpkins, water them, and harvest them when they're ripe.

blocks.text: The Wheat Fields came with an old farming drone. You write its script, and it works one shift after every delve. The field is 6 tiles wide and 4 tall, and it wraps around: fly off the east edge and the drone comes back on the west.
move(East) flies one tile. plant(Wheat) sows wheat on the tile under the drone, harvest() brings in what's there, and water() makes it grow twice as fast for a while. Every command takes one tick.

blocks.tip: Wheat is ripe after 8 ticks. Harvest it too early and it's lost. can_harvest() tells you if the crop under the drone is ripe.

blocks.text: Because the field wraps around, flying East 6 times brings the drone back to where it started. A loop can sweep a whole row, then step North to the next one:

blocks.tip: A shift lasts 20 seconds (200 ticks). Whatever grows at the end of a shift is ploughed under, so plant early and harvest often.

blocks.text: Pumpkins take 16 ticks to ripen, and one in five rots when it does. rotten() tells you, and harvest() clears it so you can plant again.
But ripe pumpkins that touch each other form a patch, and harvest() brings in the whole patch at once: n pumpkins give n × min(n, 3). One pumpkin gives 1, a patch of 2 gives 4, a patch of 6 gives 18!

blocks.tip: Wait until every pumpkin in a patch is ripe before you harvest it, and replant rotten ones quickly: a rotten pumpkin splits a patch in two.
